content: An insurgency is an organized rebellion or violent uprising against an established government or ruling power, typically involving irregular military or paramilitary forces. Insurgents seek to overthrow or weaken the existing political system through armed conflict, guerrilla warfare, and other forms of resistance. Insurgencies often aim to challenge the legitimacy of the current government, gain political control, or achieve independence or significant political change. They usually involve tactics such as ambushes, sabotage, propaganda, and asymmetric warfare.
